title: State fixes in release notes
body:
Use proper release notes on the App Store, even if you don't say exactly what was fixed.

When you get a bug report and fix it, extend some courtesy to the customer who reported it instead of pretending it never existed. At least say thank you instead of a workaround (obvious statements like "look elsewhere for info", etc.).

Btw, I want to say some of us are proud of this business. It is the only one of its kind that works (a digital bank built from the ground up, not a wrapper over a traditional bank), and that too in the UAE.

It has been getting slower over the past few months. Watch out for speed and reliability (NFRs), or you will end up with as much friction as traditional banks, or worse.

Find ways to be transparent about credit eligibility, or link out to other apps or partner with other agencies for credit score/usage.

On Wio Invest, disclose data leaks more prominently and more promptly, like the recent DriveWealth one. Consider IBKR or similar for folks who want to place orders directly.

This is some feedback from someone who has been in this industry for many years, close to two decades.

title: The best banking service so far
body:
I really love the Wio app and the features it offers. For me, it has become an all-in-one platform for banking, managing, saving, and growing my money. The overall experience has been great so far, and I appreciate how the platform continues to improve.

A few features I would love to see added in the future:

* Dark mode/light mode option for better accessibility and personalization.
* Transaction notes: When making a transaction, there should be an option to add personal notes or labels to track where money is spent and manage finances more effectively.
* ATM cash deposits: If not already available, adding the ability to deposit cash through ATMs would make managing money much more convenient.
* More country support: Some countries are currently not supported, and expanding availability would make Wio more useful for international users.
* Direct wallet transfers: Support for more direct wallet-to-wallet transfers would improve convenience.
* Metal card upgrade option: It would be great to have an option to upgrade to a premium metal card that’s also customizable for an additional small fee across all plans.

Other than these suggestions, Wio has been a great banking experience for me so far. I really like the direction the platform is heading and look forward to seeing more features added in the future.

title: They ban VPNs
body:
I used Wio as my main bank for a year and then they decided to ban VPNs. 

A lot of people in the UAE use VPNs because the excessive internet censorship in the country.

It’s annoying that they ask us to disable VPN and claim that it’s to protect our account. It’s such obvious nonsense. 

To add insult to injury, after they show you the VPN error message, you have to manually kill the app, log in again, and then dismiss all the first-time-user pop ups. It’s such a horrible experience. 

Wio is the only bank I know that blocks VPNs. 

I used to use Wio daily. But ever since they made it so cumbersome to check our account status, I’ve been switching over much of my banking to a competitor. Eventually I’ll close my Wio account.
